mapper.sql: COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN i.result = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN i.result = 'FAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail_count, SUM(CASE WHEN i.result = 'CONCESSION' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS concession_count, SUM(i.sample_qty) AS sample_qty, SUM(i.defect_qty) AS defect_qty
mapper.select: SELECT i.type AS group_key, i.type AS group_name, FROM mes_inspection i WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY i.type ORDER BY i.type

SELECT s.id AS supplier_id, s.code AS group_key, s.name AS group_name, FROM mes_inspection i JOIN scm_supplier s ON s.id = i.supplier_id WHERE i.type = 'IQC' GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY total_count DESC
